_comment: Environment-specific catalog mappings for Cube model templating. Consumed by model/globals.py to resolve {{ catalog('key') }} in YAML models. Keys are logical names (no env suffix); values are the actual Glue catalog database names. Every key MUST have entries for all four environments (dev, qa, stage, prod) — enforced by scripts/validate_globals_json.py. Self-mapping keys (same value in every env) are registered deliberately so all catalog references go through one resolution path; future per-env divergence is then a one-line change here with no model edits.
